business_problem: With 16 million customers worldwide, bswift helps companies and their employees get the most out of their health and welfare benefits today and in the future. In late 2022, the company was divested from CVS Health and acquired by Francisco Partners.
solution_summary: With 16 million customers worldwide, bswift helps companies and their employees get the most out of their health and welfare benefits today and in the future. In late 2022, the company was divested from CVS Health and acquired by Francisco Partners. To help accelerate the migration, bswift engaged AWS Professional Services , a global team of experts that can help companies realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. The AWS Professional Services team worked closely alongside bswift, CVS Health, and Francisco Partners to plan and conduct the migration, providing guidance on best practices, tools, and strategies. This collaborative approach was instrumental in the project’s success. The migration involved several steps.
